scope: All active Lofty property DAOs; sold, inactive, archived, and entity-only roster rows are excluded.

dao_charge.recognition: Post one negative DAO expense and one equal positive ECO revenue accrual per service month. Cash settlement is a separate transfer fact and must clear the specific accrued payable without creating a second expense.

eco_downstream_costs.treatment: Both are ECO-side expenses. Record actual filing-vendor transactions to ECO and record the Lofty payable separately; neither amount offsets or replaces the DAO's 750.00 annual obligation.

idempotency: A property-month is complete only when both the DAO expense marker and matching ECO revenue marker exist once. Existing cash collection is reconciled separately.
